{{Quote|Legends say that this track retraces the route used by local smuggler, Trein Veltin as he tried to elude authorities intent on his arrest. Weaving through the streets desperately trying to lose his pursuers he made it out of the city. Unfortunately his escape was cut short due to a fatal collision with a flesh eating chuba. Since that time many have made the run in his memory. Eventually it became a semi-formal track for a thoroughly illegal street race.|The race coordinator, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:NMR">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Swoop race track: "Narmle Memorial Rally" on Rori}}</ref>}}
'''Narmle Memorial Rally''' was an illegal [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] competition held on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The track weaved through the streets of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] and in the neighboring [[Narmle Swamp|swamp]]. Legends said that this track retraced a route used by the local smuggler [[Trein Veltin]], who tried to elude the authorities intent on his arrest. His escape was cut short due to a fatal collision with a flesh eating [[Gorg/Legends|chuba]]. Since that incident many swoop racers have raced this track in his memory. Eventually it became a semi-formal track for an illegal street race.<ref name="SWG:NMR" />

[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] and [[Kimmi Chyler]] run in the Narmle Memorial Rally after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="LS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Narmle Memorial Rally appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NMR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Narmle Memorial Rally was added to the game with an [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 20 December 04|update]] released on [[December 20]], [[2004]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes - December 20, 2004: 3 New Swoop Tracks!">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=390|text=Update Notes - December 20, 2004: 3 New Swoop Tracks!}}</ref>
